rowText: As DRG-01 with the knowledge base off -- run only if Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is still on the Recent Games row tonight.
steps: Checked the Recent Games shelf while launching Hades: it showed Half-Life 2, Hollow Knight, Black Mesa, God of War and Hades. Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor was not on it.
verdictSentence: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is not on tonight's Recent Games row, and the row's own instructions say to run this only if it is, so this row is skipped rather than run.
